{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/penguins.csv')

# Check for missing values in body_mass_g
print('Missing values in body_mass_g:', penguins['body_mass_g'].isnull().sum())

# Show the distribution of body_mass_g
print('\nBody mass summary:')
print(penguins['body_mass_g'].describe())

# Drop rows with missing body_mass_g as per the instruction to ignore missing values
penguins_clean = penguins.dropna(subset=['body_mass_g'])

# Compute mean body mass in grams
mean_body_mass = penguins_clean['body_mass_g'].mean()

print(f'\nMean body mass (grams): {mean_body_mass}')"}
